# Getting Started

## Installation

Install sqlpipe with a single command:

```bash
curl -sSL https://get.sqlpipe.dev | sh
```

This downloads the latest binary and places it on your `PATH`. Verify the installation with `sqlpipe --version`.

## Configuration

Create a configuration file named `sqlpipe.yaml` in your project directory. This file defines your data sources, pipelines, and execution settings. Start from a template:

```bash
sqlpipe init
```

Edit `sqlpipe.yaml` to point at your databases and describe the transformations you want to run. Detailed configuration options are covered in the [Configuration Reference](#).

## Your First Run

Execute your pipeline with:

```bash
sqlpipe run --config sqlpipe.yaml
```

sqlpipe reads the config, connects to your sources, and processes the defined steps. Check the console output for progress and any validation errors.
